source_quote: Patient had failed or incomplete colonoscopy

criteria.description: Diagnostic evaluation of the colon required
Patient had a prior failed or technically incomplete conventional optical colonoscopy

required_documentation: Endoscopy report documenting failure or technical inability to reach the cecum during optical colonoscopy
review_notes: Diagnostic virtual colonoscopy indicated following failed conventional optical endoscopy.

source_quote: As an alternative to colonoscopy in individuals at increased risk for colorectal cancer AND a contraindication to colonoscopy has been provided:

criteria.description: Colorectal cancer screening requested in patient at increased risk
Clinical documentation of medical contraindication to optical colonoscopy (e.g. bleeding disorder, severe cardiopulmonary disease, obstructing lesion)

required_documentation: Gastroenterology or surgical documentation specifying the medical contraindication to optical colonoscopy
review_notes: Screening virtual colonoscopy in high risk patients requiring explicit contraindication to standard optical colonoscopy.

source_section: INDICATIONS FOR CT BONE DENSITY STUDY / Screening for Asymptomatic Low Bone Mineral Density
source_quote: Screening for Asymptomatic Low Bone Mineral Density
clinical_service_or_procedure: Quantitative Computed Tomography (QCT) Bone Density Study

criteria.description: Screening or diagnostic assessment of low bone mineral density (osteopenia or osteoporosis)

required_documentation: Clinical notes detailing fracture risk factors, postmenopausal status, or reason QCT is requested over standard DXA
review_notes: QCT bone density indication for spinal or peripheral bone mineral evaluation.

source_quote: Requests for these services should always be approved. This organization does not review these for medical necessity.
clinical_service_or_procedure: CT or MRI Guidance for Needle Placement

criteria.description: Requested procedure code represents CT or MRI guidance component of an interventional needle placement

required_documentation: Procedural order specifying primary interventional procedure (biopsy, drainage, localization)
review_notes: Administrative policy rule: imaging guidance codes are exempt from medical necessity utilization review and are always approvable.

source_section: INDICATIONS / For Annual Screening / Group 1 - High Risk for Lung Cancer (3,4)
source_quote: Group 1 - High Risk for Lung Cancer (3,4)
clinical_service_or_procedure: Low Dose CT (LDCT) for Lung Cancer Screening

criteria.description: Patient age is between 50 and 80 years old
Documented smoking history of at least 20 pack-years
Patient is currently smoking or has quit smoking within the past 15 years

required_documentation: Shared decision-making visit notes documenting pack-years, smoking cessation counseling, and absence of lung cancer signs
review_notes: USPSTF and CMS aligned annual LDCT lung cancer screening criteria.

source_quote: Low Field MRI services are not considered to be medically necessary.

criteria.description: Imaging requested utilizes low-field strength magnetic resonance scanner

required_documentation: Ordering documentation verifying field strength of requested scanner
exclusion_conditions: Low-field MRI (< 1.0 Tesla) services are non-covered as not medically necessary
review_notes: Universal categorical non-coverage exclusion for low field strength MRI.
